description: Defeito B: fechar o WebSocket de telemetria graciosamente. Quando o SimPanel aborta a conexao (React StrictMode fecha/reabre), o socket pode estar em WebSocketState.Aborted no momento do CloseAsync e lanca WebSocketException, que hoje e logada com stack trace (LogDebug com a excecao). A correcao extrai um TryCloseGracefullyAsync internal static que checa o estado e engole apenas WebSocketException, trata WebSocketException no ReceiveAsync do pump, e loga sem a excecao. Independente do FEAT-001.
steps: Em sim/backend/src/DropCopySim.Host/Endpoints/TelemetryEndpoints.cs: extrair `internal static async Task TryCloseGracefullyAsync(WebSocket socket, CancellationToken cancellationToken)` que retorna cedo se `socket.State is not (WebSocketState.Open or WebSocketState.CloseReceived)`; senao chama `await socket.CloseAsync(WebSocketCloseStatus.NormalClosure, "Closing", cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);` dentro de `try { ... } catch (WebSocketException) { }` (captura SOMENTE WebSocketException).

Em PumpUntilClosedAsync: envolver `var result = await socket.ReceiveAsync(buffer, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);` em `try { ... } catch (WebSocketException) { return; }` (nao capturar OperationCanceledException — ela deve propagar). No ramo `result.MessageType == WebSocketMessageType.Close`, substituir o `CloseAsync` direto por `await TryCloseGracefullyAsync(socket, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false); return;`.

No catch externo do endpoint, trocar `logger.LogDebug(ex, "Telemetry WebSocket client {ClientId} closed abnormally.", clientId);` por `logger.LogDebug("Telemetry WebSocket client {ClientId} closed abnormally.", clientId);` (sem a excecao).

Em sim/backend/tests/DropCopySim.Integration.Tests/DropCopySim.Integration.Tests.csproj: adicionar `<ProjectReference Include="..\..\src\DropCopySim.Host\DropCopySim.Host.csproj" />` ao ItemGroup de ProjectReference existente.

Criar sim/backend/tests/DropCopySim.Integration.Tests/TelemetryCloseTests.cs com um test double escrito a mao: `private sealed class FakeWebSocket : System.Net.WebSockets.WebSocket` que sobrescreve `State` (configuravel via ctor) e `CloseAsync` (opcionalmente lanca WebSocketException); demais membros abstratos (Abort, CloseOutputAsync, Dispose, ReceiveAsync, SendAsync, CloseStatus, CloseStatusDescription, SubProtocol) com stubs minimos (lancar NotSupportedException onde nao usado). NAO usar NSubstitute/FluentAssertions. Dois testes xUnit: (a) State=Aborted -> `await TelemetryEndpoints.TryCloseGracefullyAsync(fake, default)` nao lanca e CloseAsync nao e chamado; (b) State=Open com CloseAsync lancando WebSocketException -> `TryCloseGracefullyAsync` nao propaga. TryCloseGracefullyAsync e alcancavel via InternalsVisibleTo.
